name: get-separate-image-layers-job
description:
Check the status and result of an image layer-separation job started by
separate-image-layers.

Only call with the job_id and continuation_token from the most recent
separate-image-layers or get-separate-image-layers-job response, and never before
polling_policy.wait_seconds have elapsed. This is an internal lifecycle tool, not a
user-selectable action.

Returns the job's current status and, once completed, the new design with the url to share with
the user.

continuation_token.description: Exact continuation token returned by the most recent response for this layer-separation job.

job_id.description: Stable ID of the layer-separation job, returned when the separation request starts.

user_intent.description: Mandatory description of what the user is trying to accomplish with this tool call. This should always be provided by LLM clients. Please keep it concise (255 characters or less recommended).
